l.i: Communis notio non opinione aut affectu, sed Scriptura, Ratione,

main_text.l: & Experientiâ duce accommodari debet ad circumstantias. Cæ-
terum quando dicimus, huiusmodi principia naturaliter
nobis esse infita, nobisque concreata, non intelligimus
literas & syllabas, sed rem ipsam: neque intelligimus na-
turas distortas & Cyclopicas, de quibus Psalm. 14. sed
re-ste se habentes: denique non intelligimus facultatem in-
telligendi omnibus infitam, sed species quasdam intel-
lectui agenti impressas, quæ in omnibus hominibus sunt
eædem. Rom. 2. vers. 14. 15. Atque hic est secundus gradus
principiorum. In tertio, eoque infimo, gradu sunt principia
naturalia acquisita per institutionem humanam: cuius-
modi sunt innumera philosophorum principia. Varietas
ista graduum certitudinis & dignitatis parit varia princi-
piorum nomina, quibus ipsa appellantur: puta, princi-
pia αὐτόπιστα[?] & ἀξιώματα, axiomata primò prima, principia
illimitata, principia limitata, postulata, petitiones, pro-
nuntiata honoraria, &c.
III.
HEXILOGIA SACRA.
I. HExilogia sacra est secunda pars præc-
ognitorum, ex s.[?] Scriptura monstrans ha-
bitum illum, qui nos in facultatibus instar
luminis dirigit in cognoscendo & agendo. Habitus

l.i: est qualitas firma, per quam homo potest agere expeditè.

main_text.l: Estque

page.notes: Marginal line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20 are printed at the left and are recorded as notes; 25, 30 and 35 are printed beside lines 25, 30 and 35 and are not placed at their exact spots. The initial H of "HExilogia" is a large initial letter joined to the first word. "ex s.[?]" is uncertain: the abbreviation may be "s." or "f." and is marked. The Greek "αὐτόπιστα[?]" is uncertain in its letters. Catchword "Eftque" is shown as printed with long s replaced by plain s. The line "Estque" is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
